title: GARbro
shortDescription: Browse game resources, preview media and extract archives.
description:
Open game resource archives and folders, look through their contents and extract the files you need. Preview images, text, audio and video without leaving the app. Playback starts only when you press Play.

Browse nested archives, extract recursively, create supported archive formats and convert images or audio. Choose filename encoding, output location, conflict handling and optional cleanup of extracted copies. Your source game files are preserved.

GARbro includes light and dark themes, English, Simplified Chinese, Russian and Japanese interfaces, configurable keyboard shortcuts, offline help and a command-line tool. The Store package includes the required .NET runtime.

Some game-specific encryption methods and format variants are unsupported or unverified. You must supply any required game keys or passwords. GARbro does not include game assets.
features: Manual image, audio and video preview
English, Simplified Chinese, Russian and Japanese
Configurable keyboard shortcuts and archive file associations
